about: Exact Kingman (constant size) branch-length moments for n = 8 haploid samples with the two sites completely linked (one shared genealogy): E_Li[i-1] = E[L_i] = 2/i and E_LiLj['i,j'] = E[L_i L_j], 1 <= i <= j <= 7, as num/den strings in pair_keys(8) order, time in coalescent units (pair coalescence rate 1). 'pooled' is E_LiLj normalized to unit sum over the 28 pairs (sum_pairs), which is the expectation of twowindow_sim.pool_pairs(M) for an arm with no between-window process (diagonal-doubled convention; scale free); E_Ltot2 = E[L_tot^2] sums ordered pairs. Generated by the exact linked-pair engine of popcorn.twosfs along two independent decompositions (lambda_moments with kingman_rate, and kingman_moments_route2), which agree exactly, and identical to the exact Kingman moments shipped for popcorn.twolocus (reference/twolocus/kingman_n8_exact.json: E_LiLj, pool_pairs, E_L2_analytic).
